{{Quote|Two days ago the Imperials launched a multiple attack on targets in the Abrion and Dufilvian sectors. They severely damaged the military base at Ord Pardron and captured the Ukio system.|[[Talon Karrde]] to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="TLC" />}}
The '''Dufilvian sector''', also known as the '''Filve sector''',<ref name="CotG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref> was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Dufilvian included [[Algarian]], [[Blenjeel]], [[Crondre/Legends|Crondre]], [[Womrik]], [[Filve]], [[F'Dann IX]], and [[Ord Pardron/Legends|Ord Pardron]].

==History==
During the [[Thrawn campaign|Thrawn Crisis]], the sector was captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces.<ref name="TLC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] incorrectly places [[Zebitrope IV]], [[Ord Trasi/Legends|Ord Trasi]], [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]], [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]], [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]], and [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in the Dufilvian sector. Zebitrope IV is in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]]; Gamorr, Ord Trasi, and Toprawa are in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]; Klatooine is in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]; and [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] is in the [[Bright Jewel Cluster/Legends|Bright Jewel Cluster]]. Additionally, ''Rebellion'' spells the Dufilvian sector as "Dufilvan Sector," and mistakenly places it in the Outer Rim. ''[[Star Wars: Rebellion: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' spells the sector as "Duflivan" and likewise places it in the Outer Rim.
